// @CoArisingSpec(id="BAL_FUNDS_RESERVED", witness="z3-qf_auflia-bal_funds_reserved-primary")
test("[BAL_FUNDS_RESERVED] (primary) ReserveFunds -> emit FundsReserved", () => {
  const initialState: CreditBalanceState = {"availableAmount":"0.01","reservedTotal":"0.00","reservedByTx":{}};
  const cmd: ReserveFundsCommand = {"type":"ReserveFunds","txId":"","amount":"0.01"};
  const outcome = handleCreditBalanceCommand(initialState, cmd);
  assert.equal(outcome.ok, true, "expected command acceptance");
  if (outcome.ok) {
    assert.deepEqual(outcome.events.map(e => e.type), ["FundsReserved"]);
    const nextState = replayCreditBalance(initialState, outcome.events);
    const axiomResult = checkCreditBalanceAxioms(nextState);
    assert.equal(axiomResult.ok, true, `axiom violation: ${axiomResult.violated.join(", ")}`);
    assert.deepEqual(nextState.availableAmount, "0.00");
    assert.deepEqual(nextState.reservedTotal, "0.01");
    assert.deepEqual(nextState.reservedByTx[""], "0.01");
  }
});

  const initialState: CreditBalanceState = {"availableAmount":"0.02","reservedTotal":"0.01","reservedByTx":{}};
  const cmd: ReserveFundsCommand = {"type":"ReserveFunds","txId":"","amount":"0.02"};
  const outcome = handleCreditBalanceCommand(initialState, cmd);
  assert.equal(outcome.ok, true, "expected command acceptance");

    assert.deepEqual(outcome.events.map(e => e.type), ["FundsReserved"]);
    const nextState = replayCreditBalance(initialState, outcome.events);

    assert.deepEqual(nextState.availableAmount, "0.00");
    assert.deepEqual(nextState.reservedTotal, "0.03");
    assert.deepEqual(nextState.reservedByTx[""], "0.02");
